_doc: Stream E (play-test 4, S5: 'more random events: some give treasure chests (loot window like corpses), others give quests (deliver items to town, etc.)'). Small events stream A's js/sim/roadevents.js drops near a lone player in the wilds every few minutes. `rules`: firstSec = the first one after entering the wilds; gapSec = the wait between two for the same player; spawnM = how far from the player; quietM = no new event when one is already this close; lifeSec = an event nobody touched packs up after this; maxPerRoom = at most this many at once in one wilds copy. `weights` = how often each kind. CHESTS (`chests`): a lootable box opened in the SAME loot window as a corpse (each player who opens it gets their own share, rolled at the event's level with `tier`); `guards` [min,max] monsters of the nearest camp's type stand round it and the box stays shut until they are down. QUESTS: `deliver` (a stranded courier hands you a parcel for a named NPC in the nearest town), `escort` (a traveller follows you to the nearest town; ambushes on the way), `rescue` (a captive at a guarded spot: kill the guards, free them, bring them home). Quest events pay themselves when done (no walk back). `{name}` = the NPC's name, `{town}` = the town, `{npc}` = the delivery NPC, `{role}` = their trade, `{guards}` = what guards them. Rewards: `xp` = share of a level, `gold` x a kill's gold at the event's level, `item.tier` an extra roll.

chests.name: Wrecked Cart
chests.blurb: A cart on its side, a wheel gone. Someone left in a hurry.

chests.name: Buried Cache
chests.blurb: Fresh-turned earth and the corner of a strongbox.

chests.name: Smugglers' Stash
chests.blurb: Iron-bound and padlocked, with its keepers still sitting on it.

chests.name: Fallen Pack Mule's Load
chests.blurb: Saddlebags spilled across the grass. Something ate the mule.

chests.name: Hollow Stump Hoard
chests.blurb: A dry stump stuffed with a poacher's savings.

chests.name: Stolen Toll Strongbox
chests.blurb: The Hollin toll box, prised open and abandoned by the ones who took it — or not abandoned.

chests.name: Pilgrims' Offering Box
chests.blurb: A wayside offering box, its lid still sealed with wax.

deliver.name: {first}, Courier
deliver.say: My horse threw a shoe and the post won't wait. Take this to {npc} in {town}? They'll make it worth your while.
deliver.title: A Parcel for {town}
deliver.text: Carry the courier's sealed parcel to {npc} the {role} in {town}.

deliver.name: {first} the Drover
deliver.say: Fever's got me and the herd won't move itself. This letter is for {npc} in {town} — please.
deliver.title: The Drover's Letter
deliver.text: Bring the drover's letter to {npc} the {role} in {town}.

deliver.name: Old {first}
deliver.say: These roots go bad by sundown. {npc} in {town} pays for them. My knees don't.
deliver.title: Roots Before Sundown
deliver.text: Take the herbalist's roots to {npc} the {role} in {town} while they're fresh.

deliver.name: {first} the Tinker
deliver.say: Mended this lock for {npc} in {town}, then got turned round in the hills. Save me the walk?
deliver.title: The Mended Lock
deliver.text: Return the tinker's mended lock to {npc} the {role} in {town}.

escort.name: {first}, Lost
escort.say: I followed the geese and now I don't know where home is. {town}? Is it far?
escort.title: Home to {town}

escort.name: {first} the Pedlar
escort.say: Things in the grass have been following me all morning. Walk with me to {town}?
escort.title: Company on the Road
escort.text: Walk {name} to {town} — something has been following them.

escort.name: Brother {first}
escort.say: My guide ran when the howling started. I am bound for {town}; lend me your arm?
escort.title: The Blind Pilgrim

rescue.name: {first} {family}, Trader
rescue.say: They took the mules and left me tied for later. Cut me loose when they're dealt with!
rescue.title: Cut Loose
rescue.text: Deal with the {guards} holding {name}, free them, and bring them home to {town}.

rescue.name: {first}, Scout
rescue.say: Don't stand there gawping — the key's on one of these brutes.
rescue.title: The Caged Scout
rescue.text: Beat the {guards}, open the cage and see {name} back to {town}.

rescue.name: {first} the Miller
rescue.say: Please — my family in {town} think I'm dead.
rescue.title: The Miller's Way Home
rescue.text: Free {name} from the {guards} and walk them home to {town}.

thanks: Bless you. I'll stand you a drink in {town}.
I owe you more than coin.
Safe at last. Go well, friend.
